answer.rationale: With expiry in 14 days and the line at 94% of committed volume, a primary-vendor switch introduces unacceptable near-term delivery and qualification risk. Negotiate an incumbent renewal immediately, using market benchmarking and a multi-year volume commitment to pursue the mandated spend reduction while preserving established integration and delivery continuity. Verify the incumbent stability and prior negotiation outcomes before committing because prior savings may not reproduce under current market conditions.
